text: My iPhone 8 battery drops from 100% to 15% in just two hours of light texting.
ref: Ask for iOS version in Settings > General > About and check Settings > Battery for high background usage apps.

text: Why does my iPhone 7 get so hot when charging with the original Apple adapter?
ref: Explain fast charging heat dissipation and suggest removing thick case while charging.

text: My iPhone 6s suddenly shuts down when it reaches 25% battery remaining.
ref: Check Settings > Battery > Battery Health for maximum capacity degraded message.

text: Battery health shows 76% service recommendation on my iPhone X. What should I do?
ref: Explain battery service threshold and direct to checkcoverage.apple.com / getsupport.apple.com for battery replacement options.

text: My iPad battery won't charge past 80% when plugged in overnight.
ref: Explain Optimized Battery Charging setting or power management pause.

text: Phone is taking 6 hours to reach full charge with standard lightning cable.
ref: Inspect lightning port for lint/debris and test with another Apple certified adapter.

text: How do I turn on Low Power Mode automatically on iOS 11?
ref: Guide user to Settings > Battery > Low Power Mode or add toggle in Control Center.

text: Is it normal for battery to drain faster for 48 hours after updating iOS?
ref: Confirm background indexing and photo library re-scanning occurs for 24-48h post update.

text: Updated to iOS 11.0.3 on iPhone 7 and battery life is completely ruined, 1% per minute.
ref: Acknowledge frustration, check Settings > Battery app consumption, suggest force restart.

text: YouTube app is taking 65% of my battery in background even when background refresh is turned off.
ref: Suggest checking for app update in App Store or reinstalling the third-party app.

text: Phone turns off in cold weather outside when battery is at 40%.
ref: Explain lithium-ion operating temperature range (0° to 35° C) and check battery health.

text: Battery indicator jumps erratically from 50% to 20% then back to 45% when plugged in.
ref: Calibrate battery gauge by full discharge and recharge or perform a force restart.

text: Charging cable says 'Accessory may not be supported' with my original Apple charger.
ref: Clean lightning port gently with non-conductive toothpick, restart phone, test another wall outlet.

text: Phone only charges when the cable is bent at a specific 90 degree angle.
ref: Identify cable fraying / port pin damage, advise against using damaged cable for fire safety, escalate for hardware replacement.

text: Since iOS update yesterday my phone won't charge past 1% and turns off instantly when unplugged.
ref: Attempt force restart while plugged into wall power, leave charging for 30 min.

text: I replaced my battery at a local third party shop and now battery health says 'Service'.
ref: Explain genuine Apple part verification and recommend Apple authorized service.

text: Apple Watch battery dies before 2pm every day after watchOS 4 update.
ref: Unpair and re-pair Apple Watch from iPhone to clear sync loop.

text: iPhone gets dangerously hot to the touch near the camera and battery drops 10% in 5 mins.
ref: Check Settings > Battery for runaway background app, power down device to cool down.

text: My iPhone battery is visibly swelling and pushing the screen out of the frame! Is this going to explode?!
ref: Safety hazard! Instruct user to immediately disconnect from charger, power off, do not press screen, and escalate to Senior Advisor for urgent replacement.

text: I've contacted you 4 times this week about my iPhone X battery and nobody fixes it. Total incompetence!
ref: Acknowledge repeated contacts, apologize sincerely, escalate to DM human specialist for case review.

text: My phone battery burned my hand while charging overnight, I am contacting my lawyer!
ref: Safety and legal threat. Escalate immediately to Executive / Legal Safety Relations.

text: Battery drains fast AND my Apple ID was hacked from Russia, fix both now.
ref: Multi-intent with high severity security compromise. Escalate to Account Security team.

text: Battery life sucks on my iPhone 6, you guys purposely slow down old phones so we buy new ones.
ref: Empathetic explanation of battery chemistry and power management feature in iOS.

text: My phone died at 50% and now won't turn on at all, black screen no response to any buttons.
ref: Provide specific force restart button sequence for their exact iPhone model.

text: Can I swap the battery myself with an aftermarket kit from Amazon?
ref: Advise that unauthorized repairs can void warranty and safety risks, recommend official Apple Authorized Service.

text: When I type the letter 'I', iOS 11 replaces it with an 'A' and a question mark symbol [?]. Help!
ref: Guide to Settings > General > Keyboard > Text Replacement, add Phrase 'I' and Shortcut 'i'.

text: How do I update my iPhone to the latest iOS 11 version?
ref: Navigate to Settings > General > Software Update and ensure connected to Wi-Fi and power.

text: My iPhone says 'Unable to Check for Update. An error occurred while checking for a software update.'
ref: Check internet connection, delete downloaded beta profile in Settings > General > Profile, and retry.

text: Calculator app gives wrong answer when typing 1+2+3 rapidly on iOS 11.
ref: Acknowledge known animation lag issue and confirm fix is in iOS 11.2 update.

text: Control Center Wi-Fi button doesn't completely turn off Wi-Fi in iOS 11.
ref: Explain that Control Center disconnects from current network while keeping AirDrop/location active; full disable is in Settings > Wi-Fi.

text: Can I downgrade from iOS 11 back to iOS 10.3.3 on my iPhone 7?
ref: Clarify that Apple stops signing older iOS versions once newer updates are released.

text: Music app keeps crashing on launch after updating to iOS 11.0.2.
ref: Force quit Music app, restart device, or delete and reinstall Music app from App Store.

text: Notification banner gets stuck on screen and won't swipe away.
ref: Suggest lock/unlock screen or force restart to clear SpringBoard UI freeze.

text: My iPhone is stuck on the Apple logo with spinning wheel for 3 hours after updating.
ref: Put device in Recovery Mode, connect to computer, and click 'Update' in Finder/iTunes.

text: iTunes gives error 4013 when trying to restore my iPhone 6s.
ref: Update iTunes to latest version, test different USB port / original Apple lightning cable.

text: 3D Touch is lagging and dropping frames on iPhone 7 with iOS 11.0.1.
ref: Adjust 3D Touch sensitivity under Settings > General > Accessibility > 3D Touch.

text: Apps take 10 seconds to open and keyboard doesn't show up in WhatsApp.
ref: Check internal storage in Settings > General > iPhone Storage, update WhatsApp, force restart.

text: Screen brightness keeps dimming even though Auto-Brightness is toggled off in Display settings.
ref: Note that Auto-Brightness moved to Settings > General > Accessibility > Display Accommodations in iOS 11.

text: Software update says 'Estimated time remaining...' for 12 hours and doesn't download.
ref: Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage, delete the iOS installer file, restart, and redownload.

text: Do Not Disturb While Driving turns on automatically even when I am a passenger on a bus.
ref: Change activation mode to 'Manually' or 'When Connected to Car Bluetooth' in Settings > Do Not Disturb.

text: My phone is stuck on 'Verifying update...' screen for 45 minutes.
ref: Lock and wake device, if unresponsive force restart and re-verify over stable Wi-Fi.

text: Photos app shows blank white thumbnails after iOS 11 update.
ref: Leave connected to Wi-Fi and power overnight to rebuild local photo database.

text: Siri says 'Sorry, I am having trouble understanding right now' to every command.
ref: Toggle Siri off and back on in Settings > Siri & Search, test internet connection.

text: iOS 11 update completely bricked my iPhone X, iTunes restore gives unknown error 9 and screen is totally dead!
ref: Error 9 indicates NAND hardware failure or USB disconnect. Escalate to hardware diagnostics.

text: You pushed a broken update that made my phone unusable for work, I lost $5,000 in client calls today! I demand compensation!
ref: High agitation and financial compensation claim. De-escalate and escalate to senior human support.

text: My phone boot loops every 30 seconds since updating, I cannot even access Settings to DM you from the phone.
ref: Provide exact PC/Mac Recovery Mode steps (plug into computer while holding buttons).

text: Updated iOS and now all my contacts, messages, and photos from the last 5 years are completely gone!
ref: Data loss emergency. Direct to verify iCloud sync status or escalate to iCloud Data Recovery specialist via DM.

text: I'm running iOS 11.2 beta 3 and the camera has purple artifacts. When is beta 4 coming out?
ref: Direct beta feedback to Feedback Assistant app, explain beta release schedules are unannounced.

text: Phone is stuck on 'Slide to Upgrade' white screen and touch is completely unresponsive.
ref: Force restart sequence, then restore via iTunes backup if problem persists.

text: Why did you remove the headphone jack in software?! Bring it back!
ref: Polite clarification that headphone jack is hardware and recommend Lightning to 3.5mm adapter.

text: My iPhone keeps dropping home Wi-Fi connection every few minutes.
ref: Suggest Settings > General > Reset > Reset Network Settings and router restart.

text: AirPods are only playing sound in the left ear, right ear has no audio.
ref: Put both AirPods in case, charge 15 mins, hold setup button on back 15s to reset.

text: My iPhone says 'No Service' at top left even though I have active cellular plan.
ref: Toggle Airplane Mode, check Settings > General > About for carrier update, reseat SIM card.

text: Bluetooth toggle in Settings is grayed out and won't turn on.
ref: Perform force restart; if persistent grayed out, may indicate hardware chip issue.

text: How do I turn on Personal Hotspot to share internet with my iPad?
ref: Guide to Settings > Personal Hotspot > Allow Others to Join, check carrier hotspot provisioning.

text: AirDrop is not showing my friend's iPhone when we are sitting next to each other.
ref: Ensure Wi-Fi and Bluetooth ON for both devices, set AirDrop receiving to 'Everyone' for 10 min.

text: iPhone won't connect to my car's Bluetooth for hands-free calling.
ref: Forget car from iPhone Bluetooth settings, delete phone from car system, restart and re-pair.

text: Wi-Fi password prompt keeps saying 'Incorrect Password' for known good password.
ref: Forget network in Settings > Wi-Fi, reboot router, re-enter password carefully.

text: Phone connects to Wi-Fi but says 'No Internet Connection' while other laptops in house work fine.
ref: Renew DHCP lease in Wi-Fi details, check custom DNS, or Reset Network Settings.

text: LTE data speeds are crawling at 0.05 Mbps on my iPhone 8 Plus.
ref: Toggle cellular data, verify data plan throttling with carrier, test in different location.

text: Apple Watch Series 3 LTE cannot connect to cellular network without phone.
ref: Check Watch app on iPhone > Cellular to verify eSIM carrier plan status.

text: Bluetooth audio stutters and cuts out whenever phone is in my back pocket.
ref: Explain 2.4GHz RF body absorption, reset Bluetooth connection, test in interference-free environment.

text: GPS location is off by 5 miles in Maps and Uber.
ref: Settings > Privacy > Location Services, ensure Precise Location ON, calibrate compass by restarting.

text: Phone drops cellular calls every time Wi-Fi Calling is enabled.
ref: Toggle Wi-Fi Calling in Settings > Phone, test home router port forwarding / latency.

text: Cannot join enterprise 802.1X Wi-Fi network at my university.
ref: Trust root security certificate or install university MDM profile via Safari.

text: Hotspot disconnects automatically after 60 seconds if screen goes to sleep.
ref: Keep Personal Hotspot screen open on host device until client establishes connection handshake.

text: CarPlay screen stays black when connecting via USB cable.
ref: Check CarPlay restrictions under Settings > Screen Time / Content Restrictions, test original Apple cable.

text: Messages say 'Waiting for activation' for iMessage and FaceTime on new SIM.
ref: Ensure international SMS is enabled with carrier for activation handshake, allow up to 24 hours.

text: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth are completely grayed out with 'N/A' in Settings > About > Wi-Fi Address. iPhone 7.
ref: Wi-Fi IC solder fracture (iPhone 7 known defect). Escalate for hardware inspection/repair.

text: My phone has had 'No Service' for 3 weeks across 5 countries, replaced SIM twice. Escalate this immediately!
ref: Baseband logic board issue with repeated failure. Escalate to Senior Advisor in DM.

text: Bluetooth radiation from AirPods is giving me a headache, I want to sue your engineering department.
ref: Legal claim / health allegation. Escalate to specialist team.

text: My phone is dropping calls AND unauthorized $100 charges are showing on my Apple ID.
ref: Financial priority escalation over network question.

text: Does iPhone X support 5G networks?
ref: Clarify that iPhone X supports Gigabit-class LTE; 5G debuted on iPhone 12 series.

text: NFC Apple Pay won't trigger at any terminal even with card held right next to reader.
ref: Remove metallic magnetic case, test with another card in Wallet, inspect top edge of phone.

text: Why does AirDrop compress my 4K video files when sending to Mac?
ref: Check Settings > Photos > Transfer to Mac or PC, select 'Keep Originals'.

text: My Apple ID is locked for security reasons. How can I unlock it?
ref: Direct to iforgot.apple.com to reset password, or DM for secure account assistance.

text: I forgot my Apple ID password and cannot download apps from App Store.
ref: Guide user to iforgot.apple.com to initiate secure password reset.

text: I'm not receiving my two-factor authentication SMS code on my phone.
ref: Tap 'Didn't get a code?' to send to trusted device or fallback phone number.

text: How do I upgrade my iCloud storage plan from 5GB to 50GB?
ref: Settings > [Your Name] > iCloud > Manage Storage > Change Storage Plan.

text: iCloud backup says 'Not Enough Storage Available' on my 5GB free tier.
ref: Manage backup size in Settings > iCloud > Backups or upgrade iCloud storage tier.

text: How do I change the primary email address on my Apple ID?
ref: Direct to appleid.apple.com > Sign In > Account section to edit email.

text: Where do I see all devices signed into my Apple ID account?
ref: Settings > tap [Your Name] at top, scroll down to see active device list.

text: How do I turn on Two-Factor Authentication on iOS 11?
ref: Settings > [Your Name] > Password & Security > Turn On Two-Factor Authentication.

text: Account Recovery says I have to wait 13 days to get back into my Apple ID! Can you speed it up?
ref: Explain automated security wait period at iforgot.apple.com; agents cannot manually bypass security timers, provide DM assistance.

text: Bought a used iPhone on eBay and it is locked to previous owner's iCloud Activation Lock.
ref: Explain Activation Lock requires original owner credentials or proof of purchase via al-support.apple.com.

text: Received a suspicious text saying my iCloud was accessed from Moscow with a bit.ly link. Is this real?
ref: Warn that this is a phishing scam! Do not click link; forward scam to reportphishing@apple.com.

ref: Ensure Low Power Mode is OFF, connect to Wi-Fi & charger, toggle iCloud Photos in Settings.

ref: Disabled in App Store indicates billing/security hold. Direct to DM for account verification.

ref: Explain Digital Legacy / court order documentation process at support.apple.com/HT208510 and escalate to Legal Support.

ref: Urgent distress. Provide SMS fallback instructions and escalate to DM for rapid assistance.

ref: Broken SLA with case number. Escalate to senior advisor via DM with case ID.

text: How much does iCloud 2TB cost per month in the UK?

ref: Direct to reportaproblem.apple.com to submit official refund request.

text: Where can I find my Apple invoices for tax accounting purposes?
ref: Direct to reportaproblem.apple.com or check email receipts from no_reply@email.apple.com.

ref: Confirm PayPal is accepted in supported regions under Settings > Payment & Shipping > Add Payment Method.

ref: Empathetically assist with accidental minor purchase refund at reportaproblem.apple.com and guide on setting Screen Time purchase restrictions.

text: How do I remove a credit card from my Apple ID without adding a replacement?

ref: Major fraud and regulatory threat. Immediate escalation to Senior Billing Fraud Specialist.

ref: Repeated refund appeals denied by automated system. Escalate to human supervisor in DM for manual override.

ref: Multi-intent (Hardware + Billing). Escalate to Advisor via DM to handle AppleCare billing and repair setup.

text: Can I transfer my paid app purchases from my old Apple ID to my husband's Apple ID?
ref: Explain purchases cannot be transferred across IDs; recommend Family Sharing to share apps without rebuying.

ref: Direct to reportaproblem.apple.com to request refund; standard cancellation maintains access until end of billing cycle.

ref: Direct user to getsupport.apple.com or Apple Support app to reserve Genius Bar appointment.

text: My phone fell in the swimming pool. Is liquid damage covered under standard 1-year warranty?
ref: Clarify liquid damage is not covered under standard warranty (requires AppleCare+ incident fee). Advise to dry completely and not plug in.

text: How can I check if my iPhone 7 has AppleCare+ active?
ref: Settings > General > About or enter serial number at checkcoverage.apple.com.

text: My iPhone ear speaker is very quiet during phone calls, I can barely hear the other person.

ref: Mechanical button failure. Suggest AssistiveTouch (Settings > Accessibility) as temporary workaround and book repair.

ref: Explain rear glass repair procedure / rear system replacement and quote AppleCare+ service fees.

ref: Remove screen protector, clean screen, force restart; if persistent, refer to display module replacement program.

ref: Check device temperature (LED disables if too hot), test in Camera app, restart phone.

ref: Retail staff complaint. Escalate to Retail Customer Relations / Senior Advisor via DM.

ref: Critical thermal event / property damage. Escalate immediately to Executive Safety Operations.

text: Can I replace the iPhone X glass with rice if it got wet?
ref: Dispense myth: advise against putting in rice (rice dust damages ports), let air dry with airflow in dry room.

text: Will Apple replace my cracked screen for free since it cracked inside my pocket?
ref: Explain single hairline crack vs point-of-impact damage evaluation guidelines at Genius Bar.

ref: Delayed depot repair with Repair ID. Escalate to Logistics / Support Advisor in DM.

text: How much trade-in value will I get if the screen is cracked and back camera is broken?
ref: Explain trade-in condition criteria (major physical damage reduces quote to recycling/minimum value) at apple.com/trade-in.

text: Is iPhone 8 waterproof enough to take photos underwater in the ocean?
ref: Clarify IP67 water resistance is not waterproof, salt water corrodes seals, underwater photography is not covered.

ref: Press Side button + Volume Up button at the same time, then quickly release.

text: How do I transfer photos from my iPhone to a Windows 10 PC?
ref: Connect via USB, unlock iPhone, tap 'Trust This Computer', open Photos app on Windows.

text: How do I set a song from Apple Music as my alarm ringtone on iOS 11?
ref: Clock app > Alarm > Edit > Sound > Pick a song from downloaded music library.

text: Where do I find my iPhone's IMEI and Serial Number?
ref: Settings > General > About, or check original box / SIM tray.

text: How do I screen record with audio on iOS 11?

text: How do I close running background apps on iPhone X?

ref: Settings > Display & Brightness > Night Shift > Scheduled / Manually Enable Until Tomorrow.

ref: Download 'Move to iOS' app from Google Play Store onto Android and follow setup assistant prompts on iPhone.

ref: Open Wallet app > tap (+) plus icon > follow prompts to scan card and verify with bank.

ref: Settings > Control Center > Customize Controls, tap green (+) to add or red (-) to remove shortcuts.

ref: Clarify iPad runs iPadOS/iOS and does not support native Windows installation (remote desktop apps available in App Store).

ref: Cannot bypass Activation Lock for found property; advise returning device to local police or lost & found.
